proposal.reason: Main change fixes CU/CE dispatch-state application by replacing per-comm/FUNC_INDEX mirrors with a process-wide cache keyed by (device,kernel), shared across native and user paths, and by forcing correct re-apply/skip decisions from the actual last-applied kernel state. Edits in enqueue/init/comm are supporting call-site and lifecycle plumbing for this dispatch behavior, not independent communicator or enqueue policy changes.
